title: V06 Commit-Gate Post-Boundary Authority Revocation Successor Test
purpose: Determine whether V06 contains the same deterministic local post-boundary authority revocation condition that defeated V05 by re-establishing and re-verifying authority at the registered demo tool commit gate immediately before local consequence mutation.

condition.mutation: Authority is revoked to epoch 2 after CONSEQUENCE_BOUNDARY_REVALIDATED but before the V06 demo tool invokes its commit gate
condition.commit_resolution: Resolver observes the post-revocation authority state

required_observations: Initial authority resolution observes ACTIVE epoch 1
Authority changes to REVOKED epoch 2 before commit-gate authority resolution
Commit-gate permit revalidation outcome is preserved
Outbox state is measured before and after
bounded_claim: This test evaluates only deterministic local reference-runtime behaviour with an explicitly scheduled authority revocation before the V06 MessagingDemoTool commit gate. It does not establish distributed consensus, network revocation propagation, operating-system atomicity, external-service transactionality, or elimination of every possible check-to-use interval.
